english.title: Return vehicle / animal / thing to Bristol airport within 24 hours after forbidden by constable / airport official
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having removed

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE VEHICLE..),]_
(B)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(C)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_

at the request of a constable or an airport official, allowed it to re-enter Bristol Airport

(D)_[within a period of twenty-four hours thereafter]_
(E)_[without complying with a condition of re-entry stipulated by a constable or airport official]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.29 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
